name: run-ok
description: Recorded 2026-10-10 against POST https://api.bowmark.ai/v1/monid/run: a one-call script reading example.com. status ok, so one billable run. The account-specific `notice` field (a terms-acceptance reminder on the recording account) was removed. Bowmark's per-call `notes` (route narration about how the page was reached) were removed as noise; the replay asserts nothing on them.

body.script: const page = await bowmark.read.page("https://example.com"); return { title: page.title, url: page.url };
